verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Gusto supports multiple work locations with different pay schedules based on location or job type, and auto-generates scheduled regular payrolls per company pay schedule, implying multi-schedule capability. However, there's no explicit documentation of setting up distinct weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly schedules per team or a UI/API walkthrough for configuring multiple concurrent pay schedules across teams. Missing for 10: explicit multi-schedule configuration API/UI documentation, examples of setting different cadences per team, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific setup.
